question: Which of the following states was NOT formed in the year 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

__
 
• **Telangana state was NOT formed in the year 2000**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Telangana** was India's 29th state that was formed on June 2ⁿd 2014.
 
• The genesis for the formation of the Telangana state dates back to several movements that occurred in 1969,1972,2009.
 
• In the 21st century the movement for a new Telangana state gained momentum by an initiative of the Telangana Political Joint Action Committee(TJAC).
 
• In 2010 Srikrishna committee was formed to find a solution for the issue, it recommended united Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Union cabinet approved a bill for the bifurcation of the state.
 
• Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Bill was passed in 2014 with Hyderabad as common capital.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttarakhand** state is also known as Uttaranchal was formed on 8th November 2000.

 
 
• It is referred to as Devbhumi due to its religious significance.
 
• ​​The state was formed from northwestern districts of Uttar Pradesh
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand** the 15th largest state by area was formed on 15th November 2000.
 
 
• It is known as the Land of the forest.
 
• It was previously a part of Bihar.
 
 
 
• ​**Chhatisgarh** a landlocked state is located in central India.
 
 
• ​It was granted statehood on 1st November 2000.
 
• It was formerly a part of Madhya Pradesh.
